review_note: Pinned lemma 9980 assumes a local homomorphism A→B of Noetherian local rings formally smooth in the maximal-ideal-adic topology on B and concludes flatness of the homomorphism. The prepared statement has the same direction and no extra finiteness assumption.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-formally-smooth-flat}
Let $A \to B$ be a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings.
Assume $A \to B$ is formally smooth in the $\mathfrak m_B$-adic
topology. Then $A \to B$ is flat.

review_note: Pinned lemma 10016 states exactness of the Jacobi–Zariski sequence 0→H1(NL_{K/A})→m_B/m_B²→Ω_{B/A}⊗K→Ω_{K/A}→0 for a formally smooth local Noetherian map. Stage A leaves the NL cotangent-complex symbol without definition; the safe source view gives no independent definition or morphisms, making the intended standalone formulation context-dependent.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-formally-smooth-JZ}
Let $A \to B$ be a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings.
Assume $A \to B$ is formally smooth in the $\mathfrak m_B$-adic
topology. Let $K$ be the residue field of $B$. Then
the Jacobi-Zariski sequence for $A \to B \to K$ gives an exact sequence
$$
0 \to H_1(\NL_{K/A}) \to \mathfrak m_B/\mathfrak m_B^2
\to \Omega_{B/A} \otimes_B K \to \Omega_{K/A} \to 0
$$
hold_reason: NL_{K/A} and the canonical map to m_B/m_B² are undefined in the prepared standalone theorem, and source-safe evidence does not expose their definition.
proposed_correction: Provide proof-safe definitions of the naive cotangent complex and canonical transitivity maps for the Jacobi–Zariski exact sequence; submit any substantive revised formulation to an independent reviewer.

review_note: Pinned proposition 10080 gives three equivalent conditions for a local Noetherian map A→B: flatness and geometrically regular special fibre, flatness and formal smoothness of the special fibre in its maximal-adic topology, and formal smoothness of A→B in its maximal-adic topology. The preparation retains all three cases and the flatness clauses.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{proposition-fs-flat-fibre-fs}
Let $A \to B$ be a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings.
Let $k$ be the residue field of $A$ and $\overline{B} = B \otimes_A k$
the special fibre. The following are equivalent
\begin{enumerate}
\item $A \to B$ is flat and $\overline{B}$ is geometrically regular
over $k$,
\item $A \to B$ is flat and $k \to \overline{B}$ is formally smooth
in the $\mathfrak m_{\overline{B}}$-adic topology, and
\item $A \to B$ is formally smooth in the $\mathfrak m_B$-adic
topology.
\end{enumerate}

review_note: Pinned lemma 10255 assumes A complete Noetherian local with residue k and B complete Noetherian local k-algebra formally smooth over k, and constructs a complete Noetherian local C with m_C-adically formally smooth local A→C and special fibre C⊗_A k≅B. All existential conditions are preserved.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-lift-fs}
Let $A$ be a Noetherian complete local ring with residue field $k$.
Let $B$ be a Noetherian complete local $k$-algebra. Assume $k \to B$
is formally smooth in the $\mathfrak m_B$-adic topology.
Then there exists a Noetherian complete local ring $C$
and a local homomorphism $A \to C$ which is formally smooth
in the $\mathfrak m_C$-adic topology such that $C \otimes_A k \cong B$.
